articles.title: Forecasts for $1 million bitcoin price likely look too ambitious, key ratio suggests
articles.snippet: The thesis is that high yields on long-term U.S. Treasuries make non-yielding assets like bitcoin less attractive.

articles.title: UK authorities continue probe into Nigel Farage’s crypto ‘gifts’ after by-election win
articles.snippet: The UK lawmaker declared victory following a by-election, triggering a resumption of an investigation from the parliamentary commissioner for standards into his crypto donations.

articles.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin’s $116M self-custody wake-up call
articles.snippet: A $116 million Bitcoin wallet exploit puts self-custody under scrutiny as ETF inflows rebound, Strategy eyes more BTC and miners chase billions in AI deals.

articles.title: Solana’s fee overhaul increases burn and makes resource hogs pay
articles.snippet: Solana’s proposed fee overhaul would make resource-heavy transactions more expensive while cutting costs for simpler activity, and it increases the amount of SOL burned.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation pivots away from Poseidon in post-quantum plan
articles.snippet: Advances in compact proofs have erased Poseidon’s previous performance advantage, according to researcher Justin Drake.
